title: Do not add og:site_name, profile:first_name/last_name or twitter:site/creator to Base.astro; each omission is deliberate
body:
og:site_name: it distinguishes a page from its site; here the site IS the person and og:title starts with the full name. Slack/LinkedIn stack it above the title, so the name appears twice and reads as a bug. Reconsider if the site gets a brand name different from the person's, or destination pages beyond the landings (case studies).
profile:first_name/last_name: og:type is profile, but identity stores one `fullName`; splitting 'Nicolás Agustín Cribb Barbaro' is guessing (split(' ') gives last_name 'Agustín'), which breaks invariant 4, and no known consumer renders them. Reconsider only if the schema gains givenName/familyName (schema.org Person would use them too).
twitter:site/creator: there is no Twitter account (identity.links has GitHub and LinkedIn); summary_large_image works without it, only 'via @user' is lost. If an account appears, derive it from identity.links, never hand-write it.
None of these affect whether the link previews correctly.
not_derivable: Absent tags leave no trace in code; the reasons and reconsider-conditions exist only here.

evidence.summary: Emits OG/Twitter tags behind `shareable`; none of the omitted ones.
